title: Lightly Broiled Saudi Arabian Red Onion Kebabs
description: A herbal and crisp Saudi Arabian dish featuring red onions, this broiled kebab is perfect for a light and energizing meal, and is dairy-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the red onion pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated onion pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Broil the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the onions are lightly charred and tender.
While the kebabs are broiling, mix the chopped parsley and mint in a small bowl.
Once the kebabs are done, remove them from the oven and sprinkle with the parsley and mint mixture.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
